svg.text: FinSight AI MVP: high level design (serverless, deep dive)
Phase 1 scope: upload financial documents, then ask questions and get cited answers. One region shown, same setup repeats per region.
The diagram shows the standard setup. The pilot runs 1 cell, with low limits and some switches off.
Web app
Next.js: chat, upload, source viewer
Global router
Company to region and cell lookup
Other regions
Same setup, added later
Region: in-country first (in-region as fallback). Files, numbers, embeddings, logs and backups all stay here.
Edge
CloudFront and WAF (firewall)
API Gateway
REST and streaming answers, TLS
Cognito login
4 roles: Executive Leadership, Corporate Finance & Planners,
Audit & Compliance, System Admin
Role check (authorizer)
Checks user, company and role on every call
Role lookup cached briefly (shared, cleared when a role changes)
Modular Lambda functions (SnapStart on)
One small function per job, lazy imports, thin shared layer. A request wakes only what it needs.
Upload function
Gives upload link,
starts the job
Status function
Shows progress, queue place
and errors
Question function
Runs the question
flow below
Source viewer function
Opens the cited page
or table
SnapStart: keeping snapshots fresh
New version and fresh snapshot on every deploy
Scheduled weekly republish (before the 14 day idle limit)
Light ping every few minutes keeps each function active
After-restore step refreshes DB link, keys, random seeds
Heavy setup runs before the snapshot, not per request
Stateless Lambda: state lives in DynamoDB
Chat history, job status, rate limits, answer cache (with expiry)
Cache key: company, role, access scope, document stamp
Role cache lives here too (role version), not in function memory
Upload, change or delete of a document clears old answers
Functions keep nothing between requests. Redis added later if needed
Upload flow
Question flow
1. Upload form and input gate
Category, upload type (New, Update, Delete), draft or final. File type and size check, virus scan
2. S3 raw files
Saved in a folder per company, encrypted. Saved before the job is queued
3. SQS queue
One queue per cell. Per-company cap on running jobs. Failed jobs go to a retry list and raise an alert
4. Ingestion pipeline (Step Functions, scales with the queue)
4a. Detect type and route pages
Table and layout pages go to the table reader,
text pages go to the cheap reader
4b. Delta check (updates only)
Hash pages and chunks, skip what did not change.
Duplicate files are flagged
4c. Extract text and tables
Textract for scans; parsers for Excel, CSV, DOCX
Each number gets a confidence score. Low = needs review
4d. Tag metadata
Company, period, category, currency, units
Missing = needs review, never guessed
4e. Chunk by structure
Headings and paragraphs; tables are never split
Parent-child chunks, stable chunk ids
4f. Embed chunks
Context header plus child chunk (size set in config)
If it fails: retry, then wait in the retry list
4g. Save in one transaction
Chunks, vectors, metrics and version together
Job marked done only after the commit
4h. Cascade (updates only)
Recompute metrics, clear cached answers,
mark dependents stale, flag related documents
1. Input gate
Prompt trick checks and personal data (PII) checks
2. Answer cache check
Key: company, role, access scope, document stamp. Company checked again on read
3. Waiting line (heavy work only)
Quick questions first, fair share per company. Waits a few seconds, then a "busy" message
4. Understand the question
Find company, period and metric being asked about
5. Hybrid search
Vector plus keyword search via one search interface, company first. Embedding retries, then a clear message
6. Rerank (cross-encoder)
Scores the question with each chunk, in region. If it is down: use the search order and alert
7. Calculate with code
SQL and pandas do all the maths. The model never calculates
8. Enough evidence?
If the rerank score is too low, reply "insufficient data" instead of guessing
9. Model router
Cheap or strong model, based on the question
10. Model gateway (LiteLLM)
Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and more, in-region only. Fallback 3: small self-hosted last resort
11. Output gate and stream
Checks citations, numbers and PII, then streams. A failed check: one retry before the first sentence, else "insufficient data"
Bulk loads, updates and reprocess
A company can run only a few jobs at once, so one big load cannot block others
Reprocess (embedding or chunking change) is rolling: a few companies at a time, lowest priority
Every step is safe to repeat (job id, upsert on chunk id), so a repeated message does no harm
Data layer: one set per cell (pilot: 1 cell). The router picks the cell
Aurora Postgres (serverless), one per cell
pgvector, keyword search, metadata, versions, usage rows
ACID. Partition per company, row-level rule as backup
S3 storage
Raw files, folder per company
Encrypted with KMS. Saved before the job is queued
DynamoDB
Sessions, jobs, rate limits, answer cache, role version
BASE is fine. Role version read strongly. Redis later
Backups
Same region, encrypted
Restore tested
Security
Encryption at rest (KMS) and in transit (TLS)
Partition per company, row-level rule as backup
Own folder and access rule per company in S3
Role check on every call (4 roles)
Audit logs: CloudTrail plus audit table, write-once copy
Observability and cost
X-Ray traces every step of every request
CloudWatch logs and error alerts
Cost tracker: per company, per service and per model (LLM)
Latency dashboards: p95, p99, p99.9 first response
Slow or failed jobs raise an alert
Queue wait and retry counts on every trace
Quality checks
Golden set of 100+ questions, run on every release
Every answer must carry verifiable citations
Extracted numbers and table cells checked against the source
Release blocked if the score drops
Role permission table test: every role, action, category
Numeric test: 95% or better on 100 numeric questions
Cache tests: no leak across companies or roles
Deployment
Docker for build and local run
CI/CD pipeline: test, staging, then production
New Lambda version each deploy, fresh snapshot
Gradual traffic shift with automatic rollback
Hosted in-country region first
Capacity raised before known peaks (month-end)
